status: frozen after the calibration line-shape gate rejected all three candidates, but before any time-resolved candidate spectrum or continuous-calibration control spectrum was inspected
purpose: Use calibration-pixel data only to distinguish reference-offset, temporal-slope, within-branch-curvature, branch-discontinuity, and line-fitter/control failures before freezing any replacement gain reconstruction.

time_resolved_test.bin_rule: four equal elapsed-time intervals between each frozen branch start and stop; first three are left-closed/right-open and the last is closed at both ends

continuous_control.event_selection: reselect each frozen branch from the hash-verified raw event file with TIME in the branch, PIXEL==12, and ITYPE==0

diagnostic_thresholds.slope_flag: absolute difference between fourth- and first-quartile fitted centroid is at least 0.1 eV
diagnostic_thresholds.curvature_flag: maximum absolute deviation of quartile centroids from the line joining the first and fourth quartile midpoints is at least 0.1 eV
diagnostic_thresholds.branch_discontinuity_flag: range of total fitted branch centroids within the same ObsID is at least 0.1 eV
diagnostic_thresholds.reference_offset_flag: the combined candidate centroid differs from its published target by at least 0.1 eV while no slope, curvature, or branch-discontinuity flag is present for that ObsID

decision_rules.control_failure: If any continuous-control ObsID violates either control tolerance, stop and audit the line fitter or official continuous gain application before proposing another sparse-gain reconstruction.
decision_rules.control_pass: If all controls pass, report every diagnostic flag and authorize freezing exactly one calibration-only replacement reconstruction targeted to the observed failure mode; do not choose or execute that reconstruction in this protocol.
decision_rules.no_cluster_access: No outcome authorizes reading or recalibrating a cluster sky event.

claim_boundary: This protocol diagnoses an X-ray energy-calibration nuisance only.
It cannot select evidence for a dynamic Sigma source, change the gravity theory, or use a cluster spectrum.
The calibration control and time-resolved fits remain development-only.
